submissions.title: Louisville Metro Council advances data center moratorium
submissions.excerpt: Planning and Zoning Committee voted 7-1 Tuesday to advance a proposed moratorium on hyperscale data centers to the full council

submissions.title: Posey Co. commissioners to vote no on Boberg Rd. data center amid resident pushback
submissions.excerpt: Commissioners voted no on the proposed data center in the area of Boberg and Hoenert roads amid resident pushback
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION: Posey County, Indiana commissioners rejected a proposed data center site near Boberg/Hoenert Roads at an Aug 4, 2026 meeting in Mount Vernon after residents packed the room and demanded a two-year study freeze over water and noise concerns; commissioners had earlier disclosed signing an NDA with an unnamed developer. Developer identity, MW and capex figures are not disclosed in coverage — left blank rather than guessed. Not linked to a tracked project (site/developer not publicly named).
